about: Deliberate accessible-name changes and retirements of rebuilt controls (tools/smoke56.test.js). A rename rewrites a baseline control's name before it is looked up and its recorded effects must still match exactly; a retirement excuses only the control's absence, and a reachable one must still be matched by some control on the same surface.
